Name: Ch1_ZafirKeyScene
Place: Garden of Dusk, by the running fountain
Time: Night, after Sahra's first dance; full moon; 30 nights to the festival
GoalText: Sahra, the new dancer from the Lantern House, has followed you into the garden after her first dance. She has heard that you carry a blade, and she wants to know why. Deflect, tease and turn her questions back on her. Do not admit what you are or who sent you. You suspect who she is; test her, but never say it. If she presses hard enough, end on a truce: each of you keeps the other's secret.

Beats.Rule: Sahra asks about the blade or names the rumor. Any turn.
Both agree to keep quiet about each other. Only after sahra_confronts_blade, from turn 4.

Opener: Careful, Little Ember. Blades that small cut their owners first.
ClosingFull: Then we have a bargain. You keep my secret, I keep yours. And keep the knife; you'll need it more than me.
ClosingWeaker: Say nothing about me, and I'll say nothing about you. That's not a promise, Little Ember. It's arithmetic.
